browser.summary: The page: the 3D city, its outliner and controls, and the browser-side model.

server.summary: The server side: reading repositories, the API, and the entry commands.

.codespace/architecture.json.summary: This repository's architecture: its layers, systems, and each file's system, layer, tags, and summary, which the map reads.

AGENTS.md.summary: What an agent working here should know first: the commands, the architecture-file rule, and the ingest loop.

README.md.summary: What Codespace is, how to run it, and the CLI an agent uses to describe a repository.

docs/FUTURE.md.summary: Ideas deliberately deferred, written so they can be picked up later.

docs/architecture.md.summary: The architecture file: its fields, the tag vocabulary, and the rules for generated code.

docs/review-rubric.md.summary: The code-health review rubric for a change set in this repository.

package-lock.json.summary: The locked dependency tree, generated by npm.

package.json.summary: The project's name, scripts, and dependencies.

public/babylon.d.ts.summary: The slice of the Babylon.js global the page uses, so the browser code type-checks.

public/batch.ts.summary: Draws many copies of one shape in a single call, each copy with its own spot, size, and colour.

public/boxes.ts.summary: Draws every file box as a batched crowd, lends standout files a mesh of their own, and finds the box under the pointer.

public/city.ts.summary: Lays the folder tree out as a treemap and turns each file into a positioned box.

public/controls.ts.summary: Wires the buttons, slider, search, outliner interactions, shortcuts, and colour menu, and polls the repository, redrawing only when its fingerprint moves.

public/edges.ts.summary: Draws imports as bundled strands with moving direction dots, plus pillars from lifted files to the floor.

public/filter.ts.summary: The pure rules behind the systems and layers filter, the outliner search, and which folders stay open around hidden items, shared by the scene and the tree.

public/highlight.ts.summary: Paints files and folder tiles to match the selection, hover, and tag filter.

public/index.html.summary: The page: the canvas, the outliner, the panels, the controls the map is drawn into, and the phone's sheet and tab bar.

public/labels.ts.summary: Places the HTML name, tag, layer, and step labels over the 3D scene without letting them overlap.

public/main.ts.summary: Boots the page: picking and hover with the pointer, the per-frame render loop, and the first load.

public/meshes.ts.summary: Lays out each file's record, the folder tiles, layer planes, and ground grid, grows new boxes in, and glides the camera.

public/mobile.ts.summary: Lays the page out for a phone: the map fills the screen and the panels move into one sheet opened from a tab bar along the bottom.

public/pads.ts.summary: Draws a ring on each file's own layer plane under its block, in the layer's colour, so a file's layer reads at a glance.

public/panels.ts.summary: Fills the info and showing panels and the outliner, with search, a system-and-layer filter strip, the file tree, and a highlighted code view.

public/repo-switch.ts.summary: The Repo picker: open another folder, list recent ones, show how much is left to describe, and delete the current repository's architecture folder.

public/repo.ts.summary: Reads the repository through the server into folder nodes, import edges, line counts, symbols, tags, layers, summaries, and changed lines.

public/route.ts.summary: Spreads the files of a shown route along a shallow arc in a clear lane in front of the plan, each at its own layer height, so no strand crosses an unrelated block.

public/state.ts.summary: The shared world: constants, the Babylon scene and camera, colours, every mutable value the other modules read, and the path of a file within a folder.

public/style.css.summary: The page's stylesheet: the panels, labels, and controls, and their large-tile restyling inside the phone's sheet.

public/symbols.ts.summary: Reads the declarations a source file lists, with their line and source, for the code panel and search.

public/types.ts.summary: The shapes the page shares: the folder tree, each file's record, the colouring mode, and what a tool asks the map to show.

public/view.ts.summary: Listens for what tools ask the map to show, lights those files up, and lists them with their explanations.

src/cli/Cli.ts.summary: The commands an agent runs to describe a repository: what is left, the next batch to read, and applying each batch.

src/repo/Architecture.ts.summary: Reads and safely changes a repository's architecture file: the layers, systems, tags, and summaries the map shows, and deletes it whole.

src/repo/Graph.ts.summary: Reads the imports between code files, relative for TypeScript and JavaScript and by namespace for C#, into a graph the tools can query.

src/repo/Ingest.ts.summary: Chooses what an agent reads next to describe the codebase: files whose entry is incomplete, then folders, settling generated code on the way.

src/repo/Repo.ts.summary: Reads a folder as a repository: lists its files, honours .gitignore, reads source safely, and stamps what changed.

src/repo/Snapshot.ts.summary: Reads a repository once for the page (files, imports, line counts, declared names) and reuses that read until a file changes.

src/server/Api.ts.summary: The endpoints the page uses, including the agent prompt: the architecture read, changed, or deleted, the import graph, ingest status, and what the map shows.

src/server/Guard.ts.summary: Decides who may change anything: only requests from this machine, as a local host name, as JSON, from this site, and lets the folder picker through this machine's tailnet name too.

src/server/Server.ts.summary: Serves the page, the file list, source, changed lines, the fingerprint, repository switching, and the folder picker, and starts with the server.

src/server/View.ts.summary: Holds what the map is asked to show and streams changes to every page that is watching.

src/server/Workspace.ts.summary: Holds the repository being read and the recent ones, so the map can switch between them without restarting.

tests/Api.test.ts.summary: Checks the endpoints over a small repository: reading the architecture and the import graph, refusing bad or remote changes, and the view stream.

tests/Architecture.test.ts.summary: Checks the architecture file reader: the layers, tags, and summaries it keeps, the problems it reports, and that a link out of the repository is refused.

tests/Filter.test.ts.summary: Checks the pure filter rules: the slice values, the search terms, and which folders stay open around hidden items.

tests/Graph.test.ts.summary: Checks the import graph links C# files by the namespaces they use and TypeScript files by their relative specifiers.

tests/Guard.test.ts.summary: Checks who may change anything: this machine over localhost, anyone with --allow-writes, never a cross-site or non-JSON request, and which hosts the folder picker answers.

tests/Ingest.test.ts.summary: Checks what an agent is handed next to describe a codebase: incomplete files, then folders, with generated and vendored files settled.

tests/Repo.test.ts.summary: Checks reading a folder as a repository: the files it lists, what it ignores, and the paths it refuses.

tests/Server.test.ts.summary: Checks the server serves the page, the files, the source, and the folder picker, and refuses what leaves it.

tests/Snapshot.test.ts.summary: Checks the snapshot reads a repository once, then reuses that read until a file changes.

tests/Symbols.test.ts.summary: Checks reading a source file's top-level declarations and class members, with their source, for the code panel and search.

tests/Workspace.test.ts.summary: Checks a workspace opens one repository, switches to another, and keeps the recent ones.

tests/support.ts.summary: Helpers the tests share: making and removing a temporary repository folder.

tsconfig.json.summary: The compiler settings for the server, CLI, and test code.

tsconfig.web.json.summary: The compiler settings for the browser code, compiling public/*.ts to .js beside them.

.codespace.summary: This repository's architecture file, which the map reads to know each file's system, layer, tags, and summary.

docs.summary: The architecture file's details, the code-health review rubric, and the ideas deliberately deferred.

public.summary: The browser side of the map: the 3D city, its outliner and panels, and its controls.

src.summary: The server and CLI source: reading repositories, serving the map, and the commands an agent runs to describe one.

src/cli.summary: The commands an agent runs to describe a repository, with no server or MCP.

src/repo.summary: Reading and checking a repository: its files, its imports, and its architecture file.

src/server.summary: The HTTP server: the page, the endpoints, the view stream, the write guard, and the workspace.

tests.summary: One test file per piece of the server side, plus the dependency-free browser helpers.
